stem: Choose the correct IUPAC name for $\text{CH}_3\text{C(Br)=C(CH}_3\text{)CH}_2\text{CH}_3$.

solution:

The substituents are bromo at C-2 and methyl at C-3; list them alphabetically.
Thus, the name is $\text{2-bromo-3-methylpent-2-ene}$.
